description.content: Manage Keboola users by super admins.

Disables multi-factor authentication for the specified user.

This endpoint can also be accessed using user token with feature `can-manage-users`.

The path parameter accepts an integer user ID or an email address.

response.name: MFA disabled successfully.
Returned when MFA is not enabled for the user.
Returned when the Manage token is missing or invalid.
Returned when the current admin cannot manage the user.
Returned when the user does not exist.

description.content: Returns detail of a user. The path parameter accepts an integer user ID or an email address.

response.name: User detail response.
Returned when the Manage token is missing or invalid.
Returned when the current admin cannot access the user.
Returned when the user does not exist.

description.content: Updates the specified user. The path parameter accepts an integer user ID or an email address.

response.name: Updated user detail.
Returned when the request body is invalid or the name is empty.
Returned when the Manage token is missing or invalid.
Returned when the current admin cannot manage other users.
Returned when the user does not exist.

description.content:
It will completely remove user from everywhere (projects, organizations and maintainers).
Removes also personal data of user (e-mail and name).

The path parameter accepts an integer user ID or an email address.

response.name: User has been successfully deleted.
Returned when the Manage token is missing or invalid.
Returned when the current admin has no privilege to delete other users.
Returned when the user does not exist.

description.content:
Each user can delete only own metadata. Super admins can delete everyone's metadata.

The path parameter accepts an integer user ID or an email address.

response.name: Metadata deleted successfully.
Returned when the Manage token is missing or invalid.
Returned when the current admin cannot delete the metadata.
Returned when the user or metadata entry does not exist.

description.content:
Each user can list only own metadata. Super admins can list everyone's metadata.

The path parameter accepts an integer user ID or an email address.

response.name: List of metadata.
Returned when the Manage token is missing or invalid.
Returned when the user does not exist.

description.content:
Sets multiple metadata with one call. If the given key and provider combination already exist
for the user, the data will be updated with the new value and timestamp.

Each user can set only own metadata. Super admins can set everyone's metadata.

The path parameter accepts an integer user ID or an email address.

response.name: Metadata set successfully.
Returned when the request body fails validation (missing provider/metadata, invalid key/value).
Returned when the Manage token is missing or invalid.
Returned when the current admin cannot manage user metadata.
Returned when the user does not exist.

item.name: Remove super admin privilege from User

request.name: Remove super admin privilege from User

description.content: Removes super admin privileges from the specified user. The path parameter accepts an integer user ID or an email address.

response.name: Updated user detail.
Returned when the Manage token is missing or invalid.
Returned when the current admin is not a super admin.
Returned when the user does not exist.
